scope: Implementation coverage. Missing external school facts are not marked as established. Verify release status in GitHub Actions.

items.title: Published-count rates, missing awards and mathematical bounds shown with headlines
Dated pupil/SEND/absence context and separate sixth-form results surfaced
Entry-year planner, labelled historical priority order and next actions
Same-year school comparison separates route feasibility from educational evidence
Current, recently observed, departed and unknown staff status with dated evidence
Compact navigation and first-screen staff search
Canonical subject filters and name-first search separate from editorial notes
Book, admission and school-day findings visible on their topic pages
Original IDs preserved while permitting sourced additional records
Printable filtered or selected profiles include complete details and sources
Expansion survives filters; filter state has shareable URLs
Claim-level source annotations supported and populated where established; unmapped evidence explicitly labelled
Private local follow-up planner and precise school/question links preserving existing note keys
Daily-life and subject/year evidence grids distinguish knowns and unanswered questions
Dated before/after change summaries include decision impact and sources
Question-led overview and concise answers precede research and methodology
Self-contained home lessons include prerequisites, explanation, practice, answers, checks and source maps
